queue.title: Verification requests
queue.subtitle: Sorted with applicants whose listing is already live but not yet verified at the top.
queue.noticeRich: You don't have the document.read permission: requests are visible, documents are not, and you can't approve a level. Approval requires that the decision be made by someone who could review the documents.
queue.searchLabel: Search by name, listing, or city

case.title: {name} — level {level}
case.waiting: waiting {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}

applicant.hint: Phone and email aren't shown — only whether they're verified. Deciding on the documents doesn't require the contact details themselves.

property.declaredHint: This is a statement, not evidence. On its own it isn't a basis — the domain still requires a document.
property.addressHint: The exact address isn't shown: it's only available through the right-to-let check (DEC-020). Match the address on the document against the listing's city and district.

documents.legalNoticeRich: Collecting identity documents is disabled by the verification.identity_documents flag pending legal review (LEGAL-004). While it's off, there will be no documents and no level can be granted.
documents.readOnlyLogged: can be opened only through a logged request

prior.hint: Repeated refusals for the same reason are a signal. A single refusal usually isn't.

signals.hint: Staff only. The applicant is told «suspicious activity» without detail — otherwise it's a guide to what to avoid next time.

aside.whatHappensHint: This is exactly what tenants will see. The wording states what the platform checked, and doesn't promise a legal review or a guarantee.
aside.internalNoteHint: Never sent to the applicant, by any route.

TAKE.label: Take into review
TAKE.hint: The request will be assigned to you.

REQUEST_INFO.label: Request clarification
REQUEST_INFO.hint: The applicant will see the reasons and can add to the request without starting over.

APPROVE.label: Approve
APPROVE.hint: The trust level will be granted.

REJECT.label: Reject
REJECT.hint: At least one reason is required.

decision.reasonsHint: The code decides what the applicant sees and which step they're sent to. Be precise — it's the difference between "fix the photo" and "something's wrong, unclear what".
decision.applicantMessagePlaceholder: What the person should do. They will see this text.
decision.applicantMessageHint: The platform adds plain-language explanations for the selected reasons automatically — this is only for what needs to be said in your own words.
decision.internalNotePlaceholder: What you noticed. The applicant won't see this.
decision.internalNoteHint: Visible to staff only and never deleted — the request's history only ever grows.
decision.noActionsWithAccess: No actions are available for this request right now.
decision.noActionsNoAccess: Without document access you can only view the queue.
